_note: Inaugural (first-day) flights for the Flight Viewer page. Dates/frequencies come from airline and trade-press announcements (Aviation Week, Simple Flying, Forbes, Russia Tourism News, Nov 2026) and can change: re-verify before relying. The planner posts an entry when the flight day is within one day of 'date' and a completed flight exists in Flightradar24; otherwise it falls back to the normal pool.
